author: feenberg
body:
I have been ignoring differences of less than a thousandth of AGI unless 
the fix was obvious and easy.

On Wed, 24 Jun 2026, Pavel Makarchuk wrote:

> PavelMakarchuk left a comment (PolicyEngine/policyengine-taxsim#1004)
>
> Reproduces ? large S-corp **gain** ($478K `scorp`) plus $201K interest: federal differs by ~$33,527 and state by ~$5,067. This is the S-corp/?199A treatment at extreme eCPS magnitudes (see #1018 for PE's assumptions: active QBI, QBID, no SE/NIIT). At these magnitudes small treatment differences become large absolute diffs, and the $15 absolute match tolerance is unrealistic. We generally filter `scorp != 0` for headline comparisons for this reason.
